name: Bugbot
desc: Automated reviewer that comments on likely bugs in a pull request.
desc_zh: 自动审查 Pull Request 并对可疑缺陷留言的工具。
solves: Reviewers spend the first pass hunting for mistakes before they can discuss design; the obvious bugs are already flagged when the review opens.
solves_zh: 审查者第一遍总要先找错才能谈设计；现在一打开评论，明显的缺陷已经标好了。
best_for: Your team merges agent-written code and nobody has time to read every diff closely.
best_for_zh: 团队在合智能体写的代码，没人有空逐行细读每个 diff。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — cursor.com/changelog directory）。 In-product surface of Cursor, shipped in the Cursor 1.0 release. Predates the window but is absent from the ledger, so it is recorded under rule (b). 首次公开日期来源：https://cursor.com/changelog/1-0
